# Imprompt contributor instructions

Read `CHECKPOINT-STATUS.md`, `docs/COACH-BATCH-001-REVISIONS.md`, `docs/CODEX-HINT-AUDIT-HANDOFF.md`, and `docs/COACH-REVIEW-RUBRIC.md` before any hint edits.

Keep the phone app static and offline-capable. No runtime language model, generated coaching, narrator paragraphs or hidden state sharing. Five spoken ABABA turns. A holds the single card or both cards; B has an illustrative response that actively changes A's next choice.

Review in bounded batches, not a bulk rewrite. Canonical scenes are under `examples/authoring/`. Never edit `examples/data/` directly or mark a structural test as semantic approval. Preserve card IDs, all card text, historical ledgers, deck state, sessions and QR privacy. The current global new-rubric audit is incomplete: ten pair scenes across five pairs and eighty single scenes (S01–S40) have completed coach-1.0 reviews; 116,070 scenes remain pending. The approved hamster example is a reference, not a universal template.

After a batch: build examples, run `npm run audit:all` and `npm test`, document browser test scope and pending work, and produce a runnable checkpoint. Use fresh app/cache URLs for a new deployed build. Do not silently relax failing audit gates.
